results.name: Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem coeff_mul_X_pow (p : R[X]) (n d : ℕ) :
    coeff (p * Polynomial.X ^ n) (d + n) = coeff p d := by
  rw [coeff_mul, Finset.sum_eq_single (d, n), coeff_X_pow, if_pos rfl, mul_one]
  · rintro ⟨i, j⟩ h1 h2
    rw [coeff_X_pow, if_neg, mul_zero]
    grind [mem_antidiagonal]
  · grind [mem_antidiagonal]

results.name: Polynomial.coeff_X_pow
results.source_text:
@[simp, grind =]
theorem coeff_X_pow (k n : ℕ) : coeff (X ^ k : R[X]) n = if n = k then 1 else 0 := by
  simp only [one_mul, map_one, ← coeff_C_mul_X_pow]

results.name: Polynomial.coeff_mul_X_pow'
results.source_text:
theorem coeff_mul_X_pow' (p : R[X]) (n d : ℕ) :
    (p * X ^ n).coeff d = ite (n ≤ d) (p.coeff (d - n)) 0 := by
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [← tsub_add_cancel_of_le h, coeff_mul_X_pow, add_tsub_cancel_right]
  · refine (coeff_mul _ _ _).trans (Finset.sum_eq_zero fun x hx => ?_)
    rw [coeff_X_pow, if_neg, mul_zero]
    exact ((le_of_add_le_right (mem_antidiagonal.mp hx).le).trans_lt <| not_le.mp h).ne

results.name: Polynomial.coeff_pow_of_natDegree_le
results.source_text:
theorem coeff_pow_of_natDegree_le (pn : p.natDegree ≤ n) :
    (p ^ m).coeff (m * n) = p.coeff n ^ m := by
  induction m with
  | zero => simp
  | succ m hm =>
    rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, ← hm, Nat.succ_mul, coeff_mul_add_eq_of_natDegree_le _ pn]
    refine natDegree_pow_le.trans (le_trans ?_ (le_refl _))
    gcongr

results.name: Polynomial.X
EuclideanDomain.gcd_eq_left
results.source_text:
theorem gcd_eq_left {a b : R} : gcd a b = a ↔ a ∣ b :=
  ⟨fun h => by
    rw [← h]
    apply gcd_dvd_right, fun h => by rw [gcd_val, mod_eq_zero.2 h, gcd_zero_left]⟩

results.name: EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd
results.source_text:
theorem gcd_dvd (a b : R) : gcd a b ∣ a ∧ gcd a b ∣ b :=
  GCD.induction a b
    (fun b => by
      rw [gcd_zero_left]
      exact ⟨dvd_zero _, dvd_rfl⟩)
    fun a b _ ⟨IH₁, IH₂⟩ => by
    rw [gcd_val]
    exact ⟨IH₂, (dvd_mod_iff IH₂).1 IH₁⟩

results.name: EuclideanDomain.gcd
results.source_text:
/-- `gcd a b` is a (non-unique) element such that `gcd a b ∣ a` `gcd a b ∣ b`, and for
  any element `c` such that `c ∣ a` and `c ∣ b`, then `c ∣ gcd a b` -/
def gcd (a b : R) : R :=
  if a0 : a = 0 then b
  else
    have _ := mod_lt b a0
    gcd (b % a) a
termination_by a
results.docstring:
`gcd a b` is a (non-unique) element such that `gcd a b ∣ a` `gcd a b ∣ b`, and for
any element `c` such that `c ∣ a` and `c ∣ b`, then `c ∣ gcd a b`

results.name: EuclideanDomain.gcd_dvd_left
results.source_text:
theorem gcd_dvd_left (a b : R) : gcd a b ∣ a :=
  (gcd_dvd a b).left

results.name: EuclideanDomain.dvd_gcd
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_gcd {a b c : R} : c ∣ a → c ∣ b → c ∣ gcd a b :=
  GCD.induction a b (fun _ _ H => by simpa only [gcd_zero_left] using H) fun a b _ IH ca cb => by
    rw [gcd_val]
    exact IH ((dvd_mod_iff ca).2 cb) ca

results.name: mul_left_cancel₀
results.source_text:
theorem mul_left_cancel₀ (ha : a ≠ 0) (h : a * b = a * c) : b = c :=
  IsLeftCancelMulZero.mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero ha h

results.name: IsLeftCancelMul
results.source_text:
/-- A mixin for left cancellative multiplication. -/
@[mk_iff] class IsLeftCancelMul (G : Type u) [Mul G] : Prop where
  /-- Multiplication is left cancellative (i.e. left regular). -/
  protected mul_left_cancel (a : G) : IsLeftRegular a
results.docstring: A mixin for left cancellative multiplication.

results.name: IsLeftCancelMulZero
results.source_text:
/-- A mixin for left cancellative multiplication by nonzero elements. -/
@[mk_iff] class IsLeftCancelMulZero (M₀ : Type u) [Mul M₀] [Zero M₀] : Prop where
  /-- Multiplication by a nonzero element is left cancellative. -/
  protected mul_left_cancel_of_ne_zero : ∀ {a : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → IsLeftRegular a
results.docstring: A mixin for left cancellative multiplication by nonzero elements.

results.name: IsCancelMulZero
results.source_text:
/-- A mixin for cancellative multiplication by nonzero elements. -/
@[mk_iff] class IsCancelMulZero (M₀ : Type u) [Mul M₀] [Zero M₀] : Prop
  extends IsLeftCancelMulZero M₀, IsRightCancelMulZero M₀
results.docstring: A mixin for cancellative multiplication by nonzero elements.

results.name: mul_eq_mul_left_iff
results.source_text:
@[simp] lemma mul_eq_mul_left_iff : a * b = a * c ↔ b = c ∨ a = 0 := by
  by_cases ha : a = 0 <;> [simp only [ha, zero_mul, or_true]; simp [mul_right_inj', ha]]

results.name: Physlib.PiTensorProduct.instAddCommMonoidElim_physlib
results.source_text:
/-- Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
  monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof. -/
instance : (i : ι1 ⊕ ι2) → AddCommMonoid ((fun i => Sum.elim s1 s2 i) i) := fun i =>
  match i with
  | Sum.inl i => inst1 i
  | Sum.inr i => inst2 i
results.docstring:
Given two maps `s1` and `s2` whose targets carry an instance of an additive commutative
monoid, the target of the sum of these two maps also carry an instance thereof.
